limits: Baseline negative control observed revival after backward injected repository time, including new repository instance. Guarded variant persistently latches an observed regression and denies issuance/renewal across repository reconstruction and real PostgreSQL restart. Recovery audit rollback and old-token denial survived a second real restart. Unobserved elapsed-time/backstep intervals cannot be detected by this mitigation. Real DB clock sanity passed; host clock was not modified. Precision extremes and independently verified operator time remain outside this experiment.
